name: Wolf
source:
His father, a member of the HH brothers, began keeping Wolf captive after his wife left home with their daughter.
When his father was kidnapped and murdered by Lycoris' parents, Wolf was freed.
As an orphan, Wolf was trained as an assassin at the Web assassin school, where he met and fell in love with Lycoris.
For Lycoris, Wolf is "the person whose soul is closest to her".
After graduating from the Web assassin school, he distinguished himself as Zhang Lei's right-hand man.
He is so good-looking that everyone looks back at him and he usually wears sunglasses.
After reuniting with Lycoris in Thailand for the first time in a decade, he devoted himself to her defense.
To rescue Zhang Lei from Xin Guang's captivity, he and Yvet and Ren ventured into the mansion alone, only three of them, and ended his short life there.
